name: codespaces-blank
postCreateCommand: mkdir -p .claude && cp -n .claude.defaults/settings.json .claude/settings.json && python3 -c "import nanobind; print(nanobind.include_dir())" && RESOURCE_DIR=$(clang --print-resource-dir) && xmake f --toolchain=clang --cxflags="-resource-dir=${RESOURCE_DIR}" -y
